title: Vault 112 / T. Dithers / Memory-Chip / Janus Genesis Comparative Forensics
scope: Identify the named Vault 112 human participants, investigate whether T. Dithers' simulation awareness is an intended experimental condition or a fault-induced anomaly, trace the stolen Vault 112 memory chip into A3-21/Harkness, and compare Vault 112's authority/memory architecture with Hawkar-usls/Janus_Genesis.

vault112_population_model.staff_model: Braun is the central administrator; routine maintenance is automated by caretaker robots/Robobrains.

simulation_roles_of_special_interest.Timothy Neusbaum: Timmy child role despite an adult physical body

vault112_population_model.warning: Rendered game scale does not account for all 85 planned occupants; do not invent deaths or identities for the unrepresented capacity.

t_dithers_forensics.unique_function: Only original resident who openly recognizes Tranquility Lane as a simulation and directs the Lone Wanderer toward the failsafe.
dialogue_observations: She says the environment is fake and describes the residents as sleeping/dreaming.
She correctly identifies Betty as Braun behind another face.
She knows the failsafe is hidden in the abandoned house.
She recognizes that Timmy is not really a boy.
When asked why she alone knows, she explicitly answers that she does not know and reports sleeplessness, voices and a sense that her own skin is wrong.

intentional_control_subject_or_planned_a.reason: No shipped terminal or dialogue identifies Dithers as a control subject, privileged observer, deliberate dissenter or designed memory-resistant participant. The monitor instead reports an error/anomaly and tells staff to check pod connections.

hardware_or_connection_fault_reduces_mem.reason: Her pod has explicit connection/readout anomalies while her simulation memory suppression is uniquely incomplete, but no shipped line states the causal mechanism.

pinkerton_stole_dithers_specific_memory_.reason: Pinkerton confirms stealing a mem chip from Braun/Vault 112 but explicitly states that he does not know whose memories are on it until integration into the new host. No shipped binding names Dithers as the donor/source chip.

chip_theft_caused_dithers_awareness.reason: The timing/architecture makes this an interesting explanation, and later community documentation has proposed it, but shipped evidence does not bind the stolen chip to Dithers or establish that the theft produced her anomaly.

t_dithers_forensics.best_current_model: DITHERS_IS_A_REAL_ANOMALOUS_WITNESS; THE ANOMALY IS CONFIRMED, ITS CAUSE IS NOT.

confirmed_actions: Pinkerton obtained/rescued technical diagrams from a Vault and built a Circuit Neuralizer from spare parts.
Pinkerton broke into Vault 112 and stole a mem chip from Braun while Braun was absorbed in the simulation.
Pinkerton explicitly did not know whose memories were stored on the chip before integration.
Pinkerton used the memory technology during the identity rewrite of A3-21.
A3-21 emerged believing he was Harkness, an old combat veteran who had awakened from a long coma.
Pinkerton also altered A3-21's face and reflex system, making the new identity difficult even for A3-21 himself to recognize as constructed.
consequence_chain: -> A3-21 OLD MEMORY SUPPRESSION / NEW MEMORY INSTALLATION
vault112_memory_chip_exfiltration.identity_result: Vault 112 technology escaped its original experiment and became a tool capable of transferring/implanting a constructed biography into a synthetic person.

reviewed_files.review_scope: runtime authority, God Mode limits, Free Others, memory/privacy, portable saves, exit

janus_genesis_review.authoritative_boundary: External AI suggestions are non-authoritative; state changes remain subject to the local gameplay/runtime rules when the authoritative runtime is used.
god_mode_limits_relevant_to_vault112: no non-consensual memory access or erasure
no deletion of another free will
no irreversible harm to an unwilling person
memory_privacy_model: remember only game-established facts or imported capsule content
do not invent access to hidden/private memories
reuse of personal story, memory, likeness or private room requires current consent and remains revocable
janus_genesis_review.portable_identity_state: Genesis uses explicit portable JSON saves/capsules for world and resident state; it does not claim to store or transplant a real person's biological mind.

pairs.vault112: Braun is a privileged central administrator with effective control over subjects' world, roles and memory.
pairs.janus_genesis: External AI is non-authoritative; authoritative state is bounded by runtime rules.

pairs.vault112: Original subjects cannot voluntarily exit the simulation on their own.
pairs.janus_genesis: Exit is explicitly always open; residents can leave.

pairs.vault112: Administrator may assign a new face, body age, social role and biography.
pairs.janus_genesis: A Free Other may change goals/calling, but is not player-owned and identity is not rewritten merely to satisfy the player.

pairs.vault112: Memory suppression/reset is an administrator capability and mem-chip technology can be exfiltrated for identity rewriting.
pairs.janus_genesis: Non-consensual memory access/erasure is outside God Mode; memory reuse requires current consent.

pairs.vault112: Braun functionally possesses near-total God Mode over simulated subjects.
pairs.janus_genesis: God Mode is deliberately non-coercive and cannot delete another's freedom or use control disguised as protection.

pairs.vault112: Dithers can reject the administered reality and warn an external newcomer despite the system's intended memory control.
pairs.janus_genesis: Free Others are structurally allowed to refuse, disagree, leave and maintain goals independent of the player.

pairs.vault112: A stolen opaque memory chip is moved without the source subject's established consent and used to construct another identity.
pairs.janus_genesis: Portable state is explicit JSON with declared runtime boundaries; portability is a user-facing feature rather than covert mind exfiltration.

vault112_vs_janus_genesis.strongest_parallel: Both systems treat identity as state that can persist across a change of representation, but they impose opposite authority models around who may change that state.
vault112_vs_janus_genesis.strongest_difference: Vault 112 removes revocable consent and exit; Genesis makes refusal, exit and non-ownership explicit invariants.

dithers_as_observer_comparison.vault112: Dithers is an anomalous witness whose perception diverges from the administered shared reality.
dithers_as_observer_comparison.janus_genesis: A Free Other is intentionally permitted to disagree with the player/system-facing narrative and preserve an independent path.
dithers_as_observer_comparison.interpretive_mapping: DITHERS resembles a fail-open witness channel: when the administered identity/world model fails to fully overwrite the subject, an independent observation survives.
dithers_as_observer_comparison.warning: This is a system-design analogy, not evidence that Fallout 3 influenced Janus Genesis or that Dithers was intentionally designed as a formal observer primitive.

vault112_failure: memory technology can be physically exfiltrated
no demonstrated subject-controlled provenance/consent channel for memory reuse
identity state can be overwritten by privileged operators
genesis_countermeasures_already_present: God Mode cannot erase another's memory or free will
portable state is explicit rather than hidden
security_and_provenance_lesson.future_hardening_candidate: Consider making consent/provenance for imported resident-memory state machine-verifiable in portable-save validation, so a Genesis analogue of a stolen Vault 112 memory chip cannot silently become authoritative resident memory.

ru: T. Dithers — подтверждённая аномалия и независимый свидетель, но причина её пробуждения не установлена.
Ошибка pod-соединения хорошо согласуется с неполным подавлением памяти, однако игра не подтверждает этот причинный механизм напрямую.
Pinkerton украл memory chip из Vault 112, но сам записал, что не знает, чьи воспоминания находятся на нём; поэтому привязка чипа к Dithers пока запрещена.
Украденная технология Vault 112 вышла за пределы убежища и участвовала в создании личности Harkness из A3-21.

Vault 112 и Janus Genesis сходятся в том, что личность представлена как сохраняемое состояние, но расходятся в главном: Braun получает власть переписывать Другого, а Genesis эту власть намеренно ограничивает.
Genesis строит анти-Braun boundary: отказ, выход, неприкосновенность памяти и невозможность купить или удалить чужую свободу являются частью правил.
en: T. Dithers is a confirmed anomaly and independent witness, but the cause of her awareness is unresolved.
A pod-connection fault is consistent with incomplete memory suppression, but the shipped game does not directly establish that causal mechanism.
Pinkerton stole a memory chip from Vault 112 but recorded that he did not know whose memories it contained; binding the stolen chip to Dithers is therefore not admitted.
Vault 112 memory technology escaped the Vault and participated in constructing Harkness from A3-21.
Vault 112 and Janus Genesis both model identity as persistent state across representations, but invert the authority rule: Braun may overwrite the Other, while Genesis deliberately limits that power.
Genesis implements an anti-Braun boundary through refusal, exit, memory privacy and limits on coercive God Mode.

next_gate.name: DITHERS_MEMORY_SOURCE_AND_GENESIS_PROVENANCE_HARDENING_AUDIT
targets: identify whether any shipped FormID/script binds the stolen mem chip to a specific Vault 112 lounger or resident
inspect Visiontron/memory-chip script or object records for donor/source semantics
compare Dithers physical/avatar records for intentional mismatch versus generic asset reuse
trace Pinkerton's rescued Vault diagrams separately from the stolen mem chip
inspect Janus Genesis portable-save validation for provenance of imported resident memories
test whether imported memory state can become authoritative without explicit consent/provenance metadata
design a machine-readable ANTI_STOLEN_MEMORY gate if the current Genesis schema lacks one
